security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Installs and updates formcut, formvis and formwav
bundle.longDescription: formai installs, opens and updates formcut, formvis and formwav, keeps their beta builds beside the stable ones, and adds extensions from an open catalogue. No account and no background process.
